answer: In a credentialing agent economy, each identity must stake a bonded learning transcript whose validity is checked against a decentralized ledger, so a fake account cannot ripple through peer attestations without costly proof. Sybil clusters are detected when their claimed skill graphs form a karst of hollow prerequisites, and a nebula of correlated endorsements triggers. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
